questions.text: Consider a binary tree T that has 200 leaf nodes. Then, the number of nodes in T that have exactly two children are ________.
questions.solution:
In any binary tree, the number of nodes with two children = leaves [latex]-[/latex] 1.

200 [latex]-[/latex] 1 = 199

Answer: 199

questions.text: Given a hash table T with 25 slots that stores 2000 elements, the load factor [latex]\alpha[/latex] for T is ____________.
questions.solution:
Load factor [latex]\alpha=\frac{n}{m}=\frac{2000}{25}=80[/latex]

Answer: 80

questions.text: In the given matrix [latex]\begin{bmatrix} 1 & -1&2 \\ 0& 1 & 0\\ 1&2 & 1 \end{bmatrix}[/latex], one of the eigenvalues is 1. The eigenvectors corresponding to the eigenvalue 1 are
questions.solution:
[latex]A-I=\begin{bmatrix}0&-1&2\\0&0&0\\1&2&0\end{bmatrix}[/latex]

- Row 1: [latex]-[/latex]y + 2z = 0 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] y = 2z
- Row 3: x + 2y = 0 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] x = [latex]-[/latex]4z

z = 1 gives ([latex]-[/latex]4, 2, 1).

Answer: [latex]\alpha(-4,2,1)[/latex]

Take logs: [latex]\ln L=\lim e^{-x}\ln(1+x^2)=\lim\frac{\ln(1+x^2)}{e^x}=0[/latex] (the exponential grows much faster).

So [latex]L=e^0=1[/latex].

Answer: 1

questions.text: The number of 4 digit numbers having their digits in non-decreasing order (from left to right) constructed by using the digits belonging to the set {1, 2, 3} is____________.
questions.solution:
A non-decreasing number is fixed once we know how many 1s, 2s and 3s it has. So count solutions of a + b + c = 4 with [latex]a,b,c\ge0[/latex]:

[latex]\binom{4+2}{2}=15[/latex]

Answer: 15
